description: US federal per diem MEALS AND INCIDENTAL EXPENSES (M&IE) nationwide tier table: the GSA tiers (68, 74, 80, 86, 92 in FY2026) that split a daily M&IE total into breakfast, lunch, dinner and incidental expenses, plus the reduced first/last travel day amount. The table is organised by dollar tier. Use for "how much is the per diem lunch allowance", "what are the GSA M&IE tiers for FY2026", "what is the incidental expense rate". Pass `total` (a daily M&IE total, e.g. 86) to get that tier; omit it to list all tiers. A question that names a city or a zip code is answered by rates_by_city or rates_by_zip, which return that place's M&IE total together with its breakdown. Example: mie_breakdown({ year: 2026, total: 86 }).

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own api.data.gov / GSA API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

total.description: Optional daily M&IE total to look up, e.g. 86. Omit to list every tier.

year.description: Federal fiscal year, e.g. 2026 (Oct 2025 - Sep 2026). Defaults to the current year.

name: mie_breakdown
